title: Rackspace Spot breach, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Rackspace, Platform9, BleepingComputer, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Rackspace Spot runs customers' Kubernetes clusters, and the admin console was down for days. Rackspace reportedly says some customer organizations were affected. The number is unknown.
who_is_affected: Organizations that run workloads on Rackspace Spot. Rackspace reportedly told affected customers to reissue Spot API tokens, replace refresh tokens, download new kubeconfig files and rotate credentials in cluster Secrets. Other customers should watch Rackspace's notices.

known.text: Rackspace's release notes list a November 2026 fix that closed a network exposure on Spot worker nodes as part of security hardening.
Rackspace's Spot status page says new sign-ups are restricted until Nov 25, 17:00 UTC after recent system maintenance.

not_known.text: Whether Rackspace itself has confirmed the breach on a page it hosts. Reports rely on a customer notice and a Spot team member's forum post.
Whether customer data or Secrets were actually read or misused, not just readable.
Whose credential was used, how it leaked, what the breached observability system is, and who used it.
Whether the full restoration Nov 21 is confirmed by Rackspace on its own pages.
